collectible.title: Wiz's Skirt
collectible.subtitle: A long, pale violet skirt that complements Wiz's usual coat well.
collectible.text: "Did you really want to see me like this? Ufufu! I suppose it's fine. Just this once, okay?"

collectible.title: Liquid That Only Dissolves Clothes
collectible.subtitle: "P-please don't try to pour the potion on anyone here…"
collectible.text:
After the game, Wiz calls out to you. It seems she wants you for something. She jogs up to you with a bottle in her hand, some sort of blue liquid sloshing around inside.

"I have something you might like! See, this potion—Aaaah!"

The cork dislodges itself from the bottle and falls to the floor. Some of liquid spills all over Wiz before she can stop it.

"Oh, no. And this was an expensive potion, too. What a waste… Well, you can still take the rest of it, I suppose. Sorry!"
collectible.unlock: Listen to Wiz talk about many different products. (Hint: Try playing her with a variety of different characters.)
